TOWNSHIP OF EXAMPLE PLANNING BOARD
RESOLUTION NO. PB-2024-18

RESOLUTION OF MEMORIALIZATION GRANTING MINOR SITE PLAN APPROVAL
APPLICATION NO. PB-24-09
HARBOR LOGISTICS, INC.
BLOCK 7, LOTS 12 & 13 – 400 INDUSTRIAL WAY – I-1 ZONE

WHEREAS, Harbor Logistics, Inc. (the "Applicant") has applied to the Planning Board of the Township of Example for minor site plan approval for a 6,000 square foot warehouse addition on property known as Block 7, Lots 12 and 13 on the Tax Map of the Township, located at 400 Industrial Way in the I-1 Industrial Zone; and

WHEREAS, the Board held a public hearing on September 12, 2024, at which the Applicant was represented by Dana Feld, Esq.; and

WHEREAS, the Applicant presented the testimony of Peter Nowak, P.E., of Nowak Civil Engineering, LLC, who was accepted as an expert in civil engineering and testified regarding the site plan, grading, drainage and truck circulation; and

WHEREAS, the Board Engineer, Thomas J. Albright, P.E., issued a review letter dated August 29, 2024, and the Board Planner, Susan Hale, P.P., issued a review letter dated August 30, 2024; and

WHEREAS, the Applicant requested a waiver from the checklist requirement to submit a landscape plan prepared by a licensed landscape architect, which waiver the Board granted; and

WHEREAS, the Applicant requested a design waiver from the fifty (50) foot buffer requirement of Section 190-60, which the Board denied, the Applicant having agreed to provide the full buffer;

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED by the Planning Board of the Township of Example that the application of Harbor Logistics, Inc. for minor site plan approval is hereby approved, subject to the following conditions:

1. The Applicant shall comply with all comments in the Board Engineer's review letter dated August 29, 2024 and the Board Planner's review letter dated August 30, 2024, except as modified by the testimony at the hearing.
2. The Applicant shall obtain all required outside agency approvals, including but not limited to the Somerset-Union Soil Conservation District, the County Planning Board and the Township Municipal Utilities Authority.
3. The Applicant shall submit revised plans incorporating the conditions of this approval for review and approval by the Board Engineer prior to the signing of the plans.
4. The Applicant shall provide a 50-foot landscaped buffer with evergreen plantings along the residential property line, as shown on the revised landscape plan.
5. The Applicant shall post performance guarantees and inspection fees in accordance with Section 190-70 of the Township Code prior to the issuance of any construction permits.
6. All site lighting shall be full cutoff and shall not exceed 0.5 foot-candles at any property line.
7. The Applicant shall pay all outstanding escrow fees and taxes prior to the release of the signed plans.
8. Hours of truck deliveries shall be limited to 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.

BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that this resolution memorializes the action taken by the Board on September 12, 2024, by a vote of 6 in favor and 0 opposed.

ROLL CALL: Ayes: Lopez, Greene, Patel, Donnelly, Russo, Vance. Nays: None.

Adopted: October 10, 2024

I hereby certify that the foregoing is a true copy of a resolution adopted by the Planning Board of the Township of Example.
Linda Morrow, Board Secretary
